title: Subgroup direct-load recurrence performance and correctness

sourceRevision.baselineGuardProvenance: The guard baseline records are from the preceding BM56 production candidate; that checkout has the same source tree as 90abb529.

capabilityBoundary.directLoadSpecialization: SUBGROUPS=1 uses direct named scalar loads for each lane’s eight Q and K values from C, then existing subgroup reductions.

hardware.gpuSuiteScope: Local served builds on one host; not a deployed-site measurement.

chromeProductionSuite.metric: Per-family geometric mean of three input-size median summed GPU kernel times; five measured requests per input size after two warmups.
chromeProductionSuite.aggregateMethod: Both complete runs per version are combined geometrically; no run is selected or dropped.

fullSuite.interpretation: Single-pair cross-browser regression check; timing differences are control variation, not an attributed speed claim.
